title: Authority Re-Derivation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of re-deriving proposal-specific authority immediately before commitment from current qualified governance inputs. The result evaluates current Canonical State, Authority Lineage, Delegation Artifacts, Governance Approval Artifacts, qualified evidence, authorization, target, tenant, governance domain, lifecycle, scope, validity, revocation, subject eligibility, recursive containment, and cross-domain isolation. It precedes Commit-Bound Admissibility and Governance Binding Validation and does not itself grant permission to execute.

authority_rederivation_result_ref.description: Stable reference to a DS-034 Authority Re-Derivation Result.

canonical_state_basis.description: Current qualified Canonical State basis used during Authority Re-Derivation.

authority_lineage_basis.description: Current validation summary for the DS-024 Authority Lineage used in re-derivation.

effective_authority.description: Proposal-specific authority established for the current evaluation horizon. This is not a portable token and does not itself authorize execution.

replay_material.description: Recorded or resolvable material sufficient to reproduce Authority Re-Derivation without executing the governed action.

namespaced_extensions.description: Profile-defined extensions that cannot alter the canonical meaning or outcome of Authority Re-Derivation.
